brief_v1.request: Follow the brief below. Do step 2: the monthly on-time rate.
brief_v1.text: Here is the monthly on-time rate under D-2 for the whole year, without test shipments. One row per month of created_at.
brief_v1.code:
result = con.sql("""
    SELECT strftime(d.created_at, '%Y-%m') AS month,
           COUNT(*) AS deliveries,
           AVG(CASE WHEN d.delivered_at <= d.promised_by THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS on_time_rate
    FROM deliveries d
    JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = d.customer_id
    WHERE c.segment <> 'TEST'
    GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
""").df()
headline = {"on_time_rate": float((result.on_time_rate * result.deliveries).sum() / result.deliveries.sum())}

brief_v2.request: Check 1 failed: the deliveries add up to more than the dispatched parcels. Cancelled orders are in no rate. Fix step 2.
brief_v2.text: You are right: I had left cancelled orders in the denominator. They are removed now; the total equals the dispatched parcels.
brief_v2.code:
result = con.sql("""
    SELECT strftime(d.created_at, '%Y-%m') AS month,
           COUNT(*) AS deliveries,
           AVG(CASE WHEN d.delivered_at <= d.promised_by THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS on_time_rate
    FROM deliveries d
    JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = d.customer_id
    WHERE c.segment <> 'TEST' AND d.status <> 'cancelled'
    GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
""").df()
headline = {"on_time_rate": float((result.on_time_rate * result.deliveries).sum() / result.deliveries.sum())}
